name: Mercure Bangkok Sukhumvit 11
short_description: A newly renovated 232-room Mercure on Sukhumvit Soi 11 with a 4.7/5 ALL Rating (1,570 reviews), an outdoor pool, and a club lounge with business centre.
ai_summary: Mercure Bangkok Sukhumvit 11 is on the bustling Sukhumvit Soi 11, minutes from Nana BTS station and Bangkok's entertainment and shopping districts. The property holds a strong 4.7/5 ALL Rating from 1,570 reviews. Its 232 rooms were newly renovated and the hotel features an outdoor swimming pool, a club lounge with business centre, a modern fitness centre, and 2 restaurants and bars. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: 18 Sukhumvit Soi 11, Nana, Khlongtoey, 10110 Bangkok, Thailand
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability
